interpretation: Writer64 remains harmful against same-format empty and other-note controls atK16. A possibly smaller harm than B0 is distinct from positive ordinary-G1 utility. Training loss and future-selected TRAIN oracle gains do not establish deployed benefit.
limitations: Exploratory DEV64, not official final test or independent training-seed replication.
Both absolute likelihood and content controls are retained; filler/control length changes can affect relative improvements.
Quartile/control/horizon comparisons are multiple; do not promote an isolated interval to a successful policy result.
Notes are mostly capped and longer than B0; no causal attribution to content semantics or length is established.
Fixed first4 texts support qualitative inspection only; no formal reasoning or mathematical-correctness score.
This two-arm result does not replace the pending matched raw-control64 comparison.
Checkpoint identities are metadata-bound; no checkpoint tensors were copied or reloaded for analysis.
